Description: MR60BHA2 60GHz mmWave kit (radar module + XIAO ESP32-C6, onboard BH1750 lux + WS2812 LED)
Notes: The whole Sense front end in one kit: radar IQ never leaves the module's own DSP (privacy chokepoint); UART 115200 GPIO16/17, I2C GPIO22/23. Ships ESPHome-preflashed — reflash with firmware/projects/canary-sense. Seeed list $24.90 (2026-07)
Always-on appliance — use a listed adapter (same guidance as the Display BOM)

Description: Reed switch, SPST normally-closed (tamper), hermetic glass
Notes: Enclosure-level tamper for the printed radome; wire to a free GPIO. FIRMWARE: no FEATURE_TAMPER flag in canary-sense yet — the P0 tamper signal is BH1750 lights-out corroboration (design doc §tamper enrichment)

Description: Magnet, Ni-coated neodymium disc 6 x 2 mm for tamper
Notes: Lid-mounted; separates from SW2 when the radome opens. Ni/epoxy coat for corrosion. 6 x 2, not 6 x 3: the front's pocket is Ø6.2 x 2.2 (mag_h), and the carrier keeps 1 mm under its ring - a 3 mm disc stands 0.8 proud and leaves 0.2

Description: M2 self-tapping screw, PAN head, 8mm (printed-enclosure plate)
Notes: For the printed Sense enclosure (canary_sense_enclosure.scad): driven from the back plate's recessed seats into the one-piece shell's post ends (the plate nests inside the walls, so the only seam is on the back face). Max ~0.3 N-m or the printed posts strip

Description: M2 brass heat-set insert, short series 3.5mm OD x 4.0mm
Notes: Service-grade lid threads: set screw_insert=true (posts auto-fatten), install at 220-240C (PETG) / 240-260C (ASA), use M2 machine screws (SCR8) instead of SCR3 self-tappers

Description: M2 MACHINE screw, PAN head, 8mm (into INS1, screw_insert=true)
Notes: In place of SCR3 when the posts carry INS1 - a self-tapper strips brass. The same length as the self-tapper: below the insert the bore opens to Ø2.3, so the screw runs free to its tip. 6 with seal_mid_posts

Description: #6 / M3.5 pan-head screw + wall anchor (keyhole mount)
Notes: For the printed enclosure's keyhole mounts (mount_style keyhole or both); head <= 6.8mm dia (the pocket's Ø7.0 head hole does not pass a 7.0 head), <= 2.5mm tall

Printed perimeter gasket for the sealed radome preset (opt_seal); 2 perimeters, 100% infill, slow. Radar sees through plastic, so no window — but a sealed build still needs a pressure path, which the CAD asserts: opt_weep (a Ø2 weep, no part) or opt_vent (a Ø12 adhesive GORE patch, the WAP BOM's VENT1)

Description: O-ring 2 mm ID x 1 mm CS (M2 screw-head seal, printed enclosure)
Notes: Sealed build (opt_seal): one under each back screw's pan head, in the glands the back seats carry (e_gland); 6 with seal_mid_posts. NBR or silicone 70A

Description: M5 x 25 bolt + nut (or GoPro-style M5 knurled thumbscrew)
Notes: Hinge clamp for the default mount (mount_style hinge or both): through the bracket's fins and the front's; the printed knob (part=knob, the Vision's) captures a standard M5 nut

Description: #8 / M4 countersunk screw + wall anchor (bracket fixing)
Notes: The hinge bracket's four corner holes (part=bracket, the Vision's): Ø4.8 with 90° cones for a #8 flat head (Ø8.3)

Description: Light pipe Ø3, single, press-fit (status LED to the front face)
Notes: opt_led (on in every preset): the front's Ø3.2 press-fit bore carries the kit's WS2812 to the face; cut it to reach from the LED to flush with the face. The WAP BOM's LP1 fills the same Ø3.2 bore
